question: The Raigarh Gharana is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is Kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathak:-**

 
 
• **Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. **
 
• The origins of Kathak lie in the storytelling traditions of northern India, where wandering minstrels called Kathakars used dance, music, and acting to share stories from ancient mythology and moral fables.
 
• Over time, this storytelling tradition evolved into the sophisticated dance form we know today.
 
• Kathak has developed as a synthesis of Hindu and Muslim influences, evidenced by the integration of Bhakti movement devotion, ancient Indian philosophy, mythology, as well as Persian and Central Asian artistic influences brought by the Mughals.

• **The Raigarh Gharana is associated with Kathak dance forms.**
